prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1032; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle was inspected at the shop after a sideswipe that occurred during a lane change. The damage runs along the right rear quarter panel and rear bumper cover, with scuffing and a cracked tail light lens, and it lines up well with the impact as reported. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, refinishing the quarter panel, and replacing the lens. The labor hours requested match the scope of this damage, and the parts list contains no duplicate line items. Nothing in the file points to earlier damage to this vehicle, so the estimate is recommended for approval as submitted.
